headline: Everest (EVER) posts an 83.3% gain over five days, driving the property sector rally.
market_take: Property stocks led the market with CMC up 30.56% and EVER up 22.22% on strong volume, supported by director changes at CMC. Food showed mixed signals as F&D surged 18.75% while XBIO slipped 12.5% after a SET clarification filing. Several securities triggered unusual‑trading alerts, notably volume spikes in IMPACT, WHART and STECON, and price gaps in M‑PAT and XBIO.

sector_notes.note: CMC (+30.56%) and EVER (+22.22%) led the sector higher; MK, MJD and CI also posted double‑digit gains. CMC filed director appointments and a company‑secretary resignation.
F&D jumped 18.75% with a 15.91% open‑gap, while XBIO fell 12.5% after a SET clarification filing; AQUA added a 10% intraday rise.
STECON rose 6.86% on a volume spike; PLE dropped 10% intraday; PYLON recorded a strong volume surge.
IMPACT and WHART saw high volume spikes; M‑PAT experienced a -17.65% price gap and a +17.86% intraday move, indicating volatility.
